shortDesc: Converts text descriptions of electronic circuits into visual circuit schematics automatically.
fullDesc:
A schematic rendering engine that takes natural language or structured text descriptions of electronic circuits and generates visual circuit diagrams.

Core Idea:
Instead of relying on predefined visual layouts, this project implements a rule-based parser that maps textual component declarations (resistors, capacitors, power sources) and connection nodes into a structured topological graph. It then executes layout routing algorithms to draw circuit symbols and route orthogonal wiring paths automatically, preventing overlapping lines and producing human-readable schematics.
highlights: Parses plain-text circuit descriptions into internal graph representations
Generates clean orthogonal connection routing between components
Draws standardised electronic component symbols dynamically
Reduces manual diagram drafting time for educational and engineering reports
